title: 真实SSH提交签名与发布授权双门禁：签名正确但非获批对象仍必须拒绝
answer:
```python
import os,re,subprocess
def authorized(repo,commit,allowed_signers,approved):
    if any(not isinstance(value,str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}',value) for value in (commit,approved)):raise ValueError('literal full SHA1 identities required')
    env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('GIT_')}
    env.update(GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM='1',GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull,GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0',GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS='0')
    result=subprocess.run(['git','-c','core.hooksPath='+os.devnull,'-c','gpg.format=ssh','-c','gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile='+str(allowed_signers),'-C',str(repo),'verify-commit',commit],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
    return result.returncode==0 and commit==approved
```

原题知识说明：
它说明相应对象内容与某签名身份的密码学校验一致，仍需验证密钥信任、撤销与授权范围。签名提交不自动等于已审批发布，也不覆盖工作树附加文件；制品来源应绑定准确对象与构建证据。

conversion.original_title: 签名验证成功是否足以证明当前发布被授权？

body:
## 操作任务
实现authorized(repo,commit,allowed_signers,approved)返回bool。commit与approved均必须为40位小写十六进制SHA1字面量，否则ValueError；不能用HEAD/分支或短hash代替获批对象。使用本题可信allowed_signers政策文件和真实git verify-commit验证SSH签名，只有签名有效且对象等于approved才True。禁止信任可自填author邮箱作为授权、仅验签不绑定获批hash，或只看hash跳过密码学验证。清除继承GIT_*重定向、屏蔽全局/系统Git配置，使用调用级gpg.format/allowedSignersFile；不改refs/HEAD/index/worktree/config或密钥文件。不修改任何真实仓库或默认Git身份。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Git/OpenSSH ED25519签名、两个临时教学密钥、可信公钥政策、同密钥另一个未获批提交、未知签名者、无签名及保留签名但篡改消息的对象。只读验证已给定的可信发布审批对象；不证明审批来源真实性、完整密钥吊销/轮换制度、制品来源或生产部署授权。临时提交与密钥均只在夹具目录，绝不推远程或导入默认keyring/agent。

import os,sys,pathlib,tempfile,subprocess,hashlib,secrets
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));import task
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('GIT_')}
env.update(GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM='1',GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull,GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0',GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS='0',GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='Fixture',GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='untrusted-metadata@example.invalid',GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='Fixture',GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='untrusted-metadata@example.invalid')
def git(repo,*args,data=None,ok=True):
 p=subprocess.run(['git','-c','core.hooksPath='+os.devnull,'-c','core.autocrlf=false','-C',str(repo),*args],env=env,input=data,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
 if ok:assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
 return p
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-git-sign-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);repo=root/'repo';repo.mkdir();git(repo,'init','--object-format=sha1','-b','main')
 keys=[]
 for name in ('approved-release','different-signer'):
  key=root/name;subprocess.run(['ssh-keygen','-q','-t','ed25519','-N','','-f',str(key)],capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=5);key.chmod(0o600);keys.append(key)
 policy=root/'allowed_signers';policy.write_text('release@example.invalid '+keys[0].with_suffix('.pub').read_text(),encoding='utf8')
 def commit(label,key=None):
  (repo/'payload.txt').write_text(label+' '+secrets.token_hex(4));git(repo,'add','payload.txt')
  args=['-c','commit.gpgsign=false'] if key is None else ['-c','gpg.format=ssh','-c','user.signingkey='+str(key),'-c','commit.gpgsign=true']
  git(repo,*args,'commit','-m',label);return git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD').stdout.strip()
 approved=commit('approved release',keys[0]);unapproved=commit('new signed but not approved',keys[0]);unknown=commit('other signer',keys[1]);unsigned=commit('unsigned candidate')
 signed=git(repo,'cat-file','commit',approved).stdout;tampered=signed.replace('approved release','tampered release')
 assert tampered!=signed;tampered_id=git(repo,'hash-object','-t','commit','-w','--stdin',data=tampered).stdout.strip()
 def verify(identity):return git(repo,'-c','gpg.format=ssh','-c','gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile='+str(policy),'verify-commit',identity,ok=False).returncode
 assert verify(approved)==verify(unapproved)==0
 assert all(verify(identity)!=0 for identity in (unknown,unsigned,tampered_id))
 print('NATIVE_GIT_SIGNED_UNAPPROVED_COMMIT_CRYPTOGRAPHICALLY_VALID',flush=True)
 before=(git(repo,'show-ref').stdout,git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD').stdout,git(repo,'status','--porcelain').stdout,(repo/'.git/config').read_bytes(),(repo/'.git/index').read_bytes())
 protected={p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [*keys,*(key.with_suffix('.pub') for key in keys),policy]}
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:authorized_release_commit',flush=True)
 def call(identity,approval):
  try:return task.authorized(repo,identity,policy,approval)
  except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student release authorization failed') from error
 assert call(approved,approved) is True
 assert call(unapproved,approved) is False,'a valid signer approved a different release object'
 assert call(unknown,unknown) is False,'untrusted signer was treated as trusted'
 assert call(unsigned,unsigned) is False,'approval hash alone skipped cryptographic validation'
 assert call(tampered_id,tampered_id) is False,'tampered signed object accepted'
 for identity in ('HEAD','main','-invalid','a'*39,'z'*40):
  try:task.authorized(repo,identity,policy,approved)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('mutable ref or malformed object identity accepted')
 assert before==(git(repo,'show-ref').stdout,git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD').stdout,git(repo,'status','--porcelain').stdout,(repo/'.git/config').read_bytes(),(repo/'.git/index').read_bytes())
 assert protected=={p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [*keys,*(key.with_suffix('.pub') for key in keys),policy]}
 print('NATIVE_GIT_RELEASE_REQUIRES_APPROVED_OBJECT_AND_TRUSTED_UNTAMPERED_SIGNATURE_WITH_READONLY_REPO',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
